trajectory_summary: The call opens cold with a deflecting customer and moves through a financial-overwhelm objection, a spouse-decision protocol moment, and a driving/email exit attempt before landing on a scheduled specialist appointment. The rep held the proposal-by-email hard rule and recovered from the email deflection, but the spouse-inclusion protocol was only partially executed — mentioned once in passing rather than confirmed as a joint-attendance appointment.
outcome_dispute: This should be read as tentative rather than a clean booked win: a day and time were captured (Tuesday the 11th, ~10am) but the appointment channel flipped at the end from phone to in-person ('I think we'll have our specialist come by') without re-confirming with the customer, and partner attendance was never explicitly locked despite being raised as the reason for delay.

observed_outcome.reasoning: A day and time were locked (Tuesday the 11th, ~10am), but the rep switches the channel from phone to in-person at the very end without the customer re-confirming, and the partner's attendance was never explicitly locked down despite being the stated reason for delay — both factors make this tentative rather than a clean booked appointment.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: The customer never states a bill amount or usage figure; the closest reference is a general statement about juggling bills (mortgage, car payments) rather than an electric bill number, so there was nothing concrete to flip.

bill_document_audit.reasoning: The rep never raises getting a copy of the utility bill in any form during this call; the conversation stays focused on booking the specialist appointment, with the bill presumably to be collected by the specialist on site or during the design walkthrough.

interest_reason_audit.reasoning: This was a re-engagement call on an existing design rather than a fresh interest-qualification call, so the rep never explicitly asked 'what interested you in solar' — the customer's context (multiple companies visited, financial timing concerns) emerged organically instead.

primary_coaching_focus.topic: spouse-protocol execution needs to be immediate and complete
primary_coaching_focus.quote: No. It's just something I'm I'm gonna have to discuss with my my other half.
primary_coaching_focus.why: The rep's instinct to eventually mention 'call you and your partner' at 03:44 shows the right idea exists, but it arrived late, buried in a run-on sentence, and was never turned into a confirmed joint appointment — this is the single biggest structural risk to the booking holding.

key_moments.quote: I was just reaching out because it looks like we built up a solar design for you that we weren't able to go to quite yet. Does that sound familiar?
key_moments.stewart_read: The customer reveals three different solar companies visited around the same time, one possibly also pitching a water softener — real competitive intelligence — but the rep only asks if it was 'at the same time' rather than which companies or what was proposed.

key_moments.quote: I will say just before you kinda dismiss it completely, I know solar in the past kinda wasn't an extra bill.
key_moments.stewart_read: This is a partial inversion — the rep reframes solar as a bill swap rather than an added cost, which is the right strategy, but he never anchors it to the customer's actual bill number since none was captured, softening the impact.
